query.description: Short natural-language phrase describing one thing to find, e.g. "tariff exemptions for semiconductor imports 2026". Inline `site:`, `lang:`, `loc:` filters are mapped automatically. Max 50 words / 400 characters after operator mapping.

freshness.description: Limit results to a recent window. Use it when recency matters — news, prices, releases, "this year" — and omit it for evergreen facts. Pass a named bucket (`day`, `week`, `month`, `year`) or a date range `YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD`. If the query already names a timeframe, the broader of the two wins, so this can only widen, never narrow, the query phrase.

offset.description: Pagination offset, in multiples of count. count=5 and offset=1 returns results 5–10. Range 0–9. Omit on the first page.

extraction.description: Extraction mode. "highlights" (default) returns query-relevant passages; "none" returns plain snippets; "full_page" crawls each result and returns full page content.

knowledge.description: Licensed knowledge results are included by default (core, the only mode); matching results appear in results.knowledge.

safesearch.description: Content-moderation filter. Omit to let the API default (moderate) apply.

extraction_source.description: Where full-page content comes from when extraction is 'full_page'. 'cache' is included in base cost, 'fetch' bills at livecrawl rates, 'blend' bills only for pages not in cache.

crawl_timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for page content when extraction is full_page (1–60). Omit for the default 10.

exclude_domains.description: Domains to exclude from search results (up to 500). Cannot be combined with inline `site:` filters, which map to include_domains.

url.description: Webpage or PDF URL to extract content from. Runtime validation requires a public http or https URL.

formats.description: Output formats: ["markdown"] (default), ["html"], or ["markdown", "html"]. Mapped to the Extract API `full_page.extraction_formats`.

extraction_source.description: Where full-page content comes from: "blend" (default, cached when available, crawled live otherwise), "cache" (cached only, fastest), or "fetch" (always crawled live).

timeout.description: Optional timeout in seconds (2-100) for the whole extract request, including crawl. Default: 30.

parse_effort.description: PDF parsing effort (no effect on webpages): "lite" extracts embedded content only; "standard" (default) also parses complex pages via an advanced model.

query.description: Natural-language task to find agents/tools for.

finder.description: Which external Agent Finder service(s) to query: github (GitHub Agent Finder), huggingface (Hugging Face finder), or all. The You.com catalog is always included.
